q: How does a Sivakasi printer work out carbon per diary or calendar?
title: Sivakasi printers: carbon per copy
short: Add the press's energy for the job, then the paper, board and ink per copy with supplier or database factors, and divide by copies printed. Paper is a major line, so get the paper mill's figure if you can.
audience: Diary, calendar and notebook printers in the Sivakasi cluster of Tamil Nadu

p: Press, binding and finishing kWh for the job, x 0.710.
Paper and board tonnes, with the mill's figure or a named factor.
Divide the total by copies delivered.
Count paper bought, not paper in the finished copies, so make-ready and trimming waste is included.

senseible: Senseible reads the energy invoices behind the making stage into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, and keeps material invoices on the Scope 3 trail. Material factors come from your supplier or a named database and are labelled with their source, so the product figure can be traced line by line.
